rfam.comment: The SAM riboswitch is found upstream of a number of genes which code for proteins involved in methionine or cysteine biosynthesis in Gram-positive bacteria. The SAM riboswitch acts at the level of transcription termination control. The predicted structure consists of a complex stem-loop region followed by a single stem loop terminator region. An alternative and mutually exclusive form involves bases in the 3' segment of helix 1 with those in the 5' region of helix 5 to form a structure termed the anti-terminator form [1]. This entry represents the conserved core of the complex structure involving helices 1-4. The structure of SAM riboswitch has been reported in PDBs: 2GIS, 2YDH, 2YGH, 3GX2, 3GX3, 3GX5, 3GX6, 3GX7, 3IQN, 3IQP, 3IQR, 3V7E, 4AOB, 4B5R, 4KQY, 5FJC, 5FK1, 5FK2, 5FK3, 5FK4, 5FK5, 5FK6, 5FKD, 5FKE, 5FKF, 5FKG, 5FKH, 7EAF [5-13]
